name: DIF-Net
definition: A method for sparse-view CBCT reconstruction that formulates the CT volume as a continuous intensity field $g: \mathbb{R}^3 \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$, regressing the intensity value $v$ of an arbitrary 3D point $p$ from $K$ 2D projections $I$, i.e., $v = g(I, p)$.
summary: DIF-Net is a supervised deep learning method for sparse-view CBCT reconstruction that avoids per-patient optimization and 3D CNNs by learning priors from large datasets to enable scalable, high-quality volume rendering.
